Week 20 Module Map: The Secession Crisis

Quarter 3: The Price of Union · Anchor date: 1861

The national quarrel over slavery reaches Texas, and the state's most famous hero refuses to go along with where it leads.

Your lessons this week

  • Lesson 1: The Sectional Crisis Reaches Texas
  • Lesson 2: Sam Houston and the Texas Secession Convention

What to turn in

  • Reading quiz: Week 20 Reading Quiz
  • Primary source assessment: Week 20 Primary Source Assessment
  • VR write-up: Week 20 VR Write-Up, based on your immersive session

Keep going all quarter

Read each lesson all the way through before you start the quiz. The read-aloud player at the top of each lesson can help you follow along, and the speaker button next to each vocabulary word plays its pronunciation.

Something to watch for

Honesty: notice Sam Houston's sober look at the facts, and how it cost him his office.
